posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought American Express stock, 8,028 of them from 1972 to 2004. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 47% are red.
Ten years: still 654 red.

At 22 years, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in March 1987 and was red for twenty two years. Through the 1987 crash, the dot com crash, and 2008.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded.

Follow for the next one.

Follow for the next one. Every claim on here gets tested against a control.

Follow for a new chart every day.

#americanexpress #amex #stockmarket #longterminvesting
